# OceanViewFlats

OceanViewFlats offers direct beachfront short-term vacation rentals in Playa Salguero, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia (`https://www.oceanviewflats.com`). The platform is a fast, multilingual static site with a direct booking engine across 6 languages.

---

## Global Multilingual Support

All public pages are available in 6 languages:
- **English (EN)**: `/` (default), `/Oceanview1707`, `/Oceanview1606`, `/contact`, `/privacy`
- **Español (ES)**: `/es.html`, `/Oceanview1707/es.html`, `/Oceanview1606/es.html`, `/contact/es.html`, `/privacy/es.html`

## Direct Booking, Check-In & Regulatory Compliance

- **Settlement Currency**: All quotes and direct payments (Credit/Debit Card, PSE bank transfer, Efecty cash voucher via Mercado Pago) settle in Colombian Pesos (`COP`), saving 15–20% over third-party OTA fees.
- **Mandatory Guest Registry (`/registry`)**: Per Colombian hospitality law and Edificio Salguero Sunset security regulations, all staying Guests must register identification details (and **Minor Guardian Attestation** for guests under 18) prior to arrival. Smart-lock **Access Credentials** and the **Guest Guide** (`/guide`) unlock automatically upon Guest Registry completion.
- **Building Registration Fee**: Edificio Salguero Sunset condominium administration assesses a mandatory statutory registration fee of `20,000 COP` per person payable directly at the front-desk reception upon arrival.
- **Data Protection (`/privacy`)**: Personal data is processed in accordance with Colombian Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 (*Política de Tratamiento de Datos Personales*).
